currentPriorities.title: Sentra Context Generator v1
currentPriorities.why: Hermes should be driven by Sentra operating state instead of static samples.
currentPriorities.desiredOutcome: Generate sentra/snapshot.json and sentra/promotion-input.json from projects, decisions, reviews, and priorities.

currentPriorities.title: Hermes Operating Loop
currentPriorities.why: Use the qualified promotion workflow as a repeatable decision loop.
currentPriorities.desiredOutcome: Run promotion workflow from generated Sentra context and produce auditable reports.

proposedPriorities.title: Promotion History Ledger
proposedPriorities.why: Promotion decisions should accumulate as a durable, queryable operating history.
proposedPriorities.desiredOutcome: Append each Hermes promotion result into a promotion history ledger with status, score, reviewer, and linked artifacts.

proposedPriorities.title: Multi-project Prioritization
proposedPriorities.why: Sentra should choose between multiple active projects instead of only operating Hermes Mastra Lab.
proposedPriorities.desiredOutcome: Rank active projects and generate promotion inputs from the highest-value project context.

proposedPriorities.title: Weekly Review Feedback
proposedPriorities.why: Weekly reviews should update priorities and stale risks instead of only reporting them.
proposedPriorities.desiredOutcome: Convert review outcomes into proposed updates for sentra/priorities/current.json.

reviewSummary: Sentra generated operating context, Hermes consumed the promotion input, a promotion decision was produced, and the operating ledger linked the cycle artifacts.
notes: This proposes a priority rewrite from the weekly review.
It does not mutate sentra/priorities/current.json without approval.
